implementation: compare_operation_callers@caller-comparison-v2+thrift-pairs (the exact caller comparison service, released for Thrift-to-Thrift endpoint pairs)

requires.released_recipe: phebs.thrift.caller.go (thrift-contract@1.2.0 plus thrift-caller@1.6.0-released.1), the running extractors, claim 1.3.0

admission: Admitted only through a verified signed selection beside the current released Thrift Caller Map recipe; an experimental Thrift caller generation never backs it.

surfaces.http: Existing authenticated /api/compare_operation_callers with old_protocol=thrift and replacement_protocol=thrift

excluded: mixed protobuf and Thrift endpoint pairs

migration completeness, runtime use and retirement safety
limits: Existing comparison, Caller Map, request and citation bounds; no ceiling widened; no new measured capacity or SLO.
